risk.risk: Recovery/session concurrency may allow takeover or lockout
risk.impact: Administrative access or availability is harmed; D3 is low confidence with high cost
risk.mitigation: Enforce section09/10 lock order, credential version and one-time consumption. Verify using real browser and isolated OS CLI recovery. Revoke old factors only on final confirmation.
risk.trigger: Any concurrency, expiry or replay test fails; block the affected task
